lesson.subject: Mathematics
lesson.subtopic: Plane shapes: types, properties and perimeter

curriculum.objective: State the similarities and differences between the following: square, rectangle, triangle, trapezium, parallelogram and circle
Find the perimeter of a regular polygon: square, rectangle, triangle, trapezium, parallelogram and circle

objectives.objective: identify the types of plane shapes and state their properties, similarities and differences
identify the parts of a circle
find the perimeter of a regular polygon, square, rectangle, trapezium, parallelogram and circle

references.item: New General mathematics for Junior Secondary School one page 159 – 167
New Concept mathematics for junior secondary school one.

step.title: Step I — intro: angles (previous knowledge)
step.plan-content: Teacher displays the drawings of angles on the board asking from the students at random the various angles while the students respond to teachers questions. Teacher adopts the students answers if correct, otherwise teacher corrects the student and the lesson progresses.

activities.activity: displays the drawings of angles on the board, asking the students at random the various angles
adopts the students' answers if correct, otherwise corrects the student

step.title: Step II — types of plane shapes, their properties, similarities and differences
step.plan-content: Teacher draws the various shapes on the board while students identify their properties. The teacher writes the properties of the shapes on the board for the students to learn.

activities.activity: draws the various shapes on the board
writes the properties of the shapes on the board for the students to learn

step.title: Step III — parts of a circle
step.plan-content: Teacher explains the parts of a circle to the students: the arc, radius, chord and diameter, with the circumference, segment, sector and tangent labelled on the board drawings.

activities.activity: explains the parts of a circle to the students: the arc, radius, chord and diameter, with the circumference, segment, sector and tangent labelled on the board drawings

step.title: Step IV — perimeter of plane shapes
step.plan-content: Teacher works the perimeter of plane shapes on the board: square, rectangle, trapezium, parallelogram, regular hexagon and circle, including finding a missing side or radius when the perimeter is given.

activities.activity: works the perimeter of plane shapes on the board: square, rectangle, trapezium, parallelogram, regular hexagon and circle, including finding a missing side or radius when the perimeter is given

section.heading: 1. Calculate the perimeter of a square of side 15cm.
2. Find the perimeter of a rectangle whose length 10cm and breadth 7cm.
3. If the perimeter of a rectangle is 60cm and its length is 17cm. Calculate its breadth.
4. Find the perimeter of the trapezium below.
5. Find the perimeter of the parallelogram below.
6. Find the perimeter of a regular hexagon sides 5.2cm.
7. Calculate the perimeter of circle of radius 7cm (use the value $3\frac{1}{7}$ for $\pi$)
8. A rope is wound 50 times round a cylinder of radius 25cm. How long is the rope? $\pi = 3.14$.
9. The circumference of a circle is 440cm. Find the radius $(\pi = \frac{22}{7})$
10. Calculate the perimeter of the shape below.

step.title: Evaluation
step.plan-content: Teacher test the students understanding on the topic by giving them some question to solve
